summary: 100 Cookies is 13 batches: 13 Flour, 26 Eggs, 13 Sticks. Plant Wheat early, build two Chicken Coops, a Windmill and a Cookie Shop. Maddy brings more births, so 'everyone settled' is the real constraint: keep building Plank and Brick Houses ahead of the population.

build_order.note: About 20 tiles at once on the existing Farms; 12-day crop.
Two, 9 Planks each; about 5 Eggs a day each.
5 beds for 6 Planks: the cheapest beds per material.
6 beds for 12 Bricks once the Brickyard is free.

pitfalls: The settled objective must hold when the last one completes; time the last cookies after the houses catch up.
Population 40 (optional) needs about 40 beds; Maddy helps births, free beds still gate them.
source: Drafted from the decoded objectives, starting inventory, build list, construction costs and recipes (game data 30, build 254); not yet playtested. Checks for a test run are in docs/PLAYTESTS.md, Part C.
